title: Musa: The Nile to the Mountain

bridge.where: Egypt, then Madyan and Mount Sinai
text: Yusuf's family had settled in Egypt. Generations later, their descendants, the Children of Israel, have become slaves of a cruel Pharaoh.

Musa, known as Moses in the Bible, is born into this time of fear. His story fills the next three chapters; when he flees, it is to Madyan, Shu'ayb's town (Chapter 10), where those who believed had lived on.
